messages:
Maya R.: Heads up — saw a spike in inbound leads where HubSpot fails to assign owner within ~30s because enrichment jobs are lagging. Leads are unclaimed and SLA alerts triggered this morning. Anyone else seeing this?

Jon P.: Yep, noticed ~120 affected yesterday morning. Looks like enrichment timeout bumped from 20s -> 60s on a few records, and our RR assign waits for enrichment to finish before finalizing owner.

Sophia M.: Oof. Can we tolerate an immediate temp assign (RR) and then reconcile post-enrichment? That would shrink the unclaimed window while preserving enrichment-based routing.

Liam O.: We experimented with immediate assign before. Problem was enrichment later overwrote the owner and created churn if SDR already touched the lead. Need a pattern: acknowledge -> temp owner -> reconcile only if untouched.

Maya R.: Proposal sketch (HubSpot workflow pseudocode):
```
on lead.create:
  set lead.temp_owner = round_robin()
  set lead.acknowledged_at = now()
  trigger enrichment_job(lead_id)

on enrichment.callback:
  if lead.touched_by_sales == false:
    set lead.owner = enrichment.suggested_owner
  else:
    set lead.reconciliation_flag = true
```
This way we guarantee an "ack" and temp owner quickly.

hubspot-bot: test workflow deployed to staging: hs-workflow-ack-tempassign v1. Please validate with sample payloads.

Jon P.: I like the reconcile guard. Suggested policy: ack within 20s, temp assign immediately, enrichment can update owner within 5m if untouched. If reconciliation_flag=true, enqueue manual review by sales-ops. Also log events to BigQuery for SLA dashboards. :+1:

Sophia M.: I'll draft the playbook language for handoff SLAs: ack <=20s, temp owner in <30s, final owner settle <=5m, escalate to SDR manager if unacked >5m. I'll add the exact queries for the metrics dashboard.

Liam O.: I'll roll the staging workflow today and run a 1k lead synthetic test. Will report timings and any owner flip noise. @Maya R. can you add the reconciliation section to runbook (steps, who to ping)?

Maya R.: On it — will update the handoff runbook and notify ops + sales-ops. Also creating an alert: if >2% of leads unacked over a 24h window create a pager and a postmortem stub.

Jon P.: Good plan. Once staging looks clean, we can ship to prod with a 2-week ramp. @Sophia M. please loop in sales-ops for acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone.
